title: "Season"
subtitle: "Standings, all-play, and luck"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
source(here::here("R/fleaflicker.R"))
source(here::here("R/analytics.R"))
source(here::here("R/tables.R"))
source(here::here("R/season.R"))

LEAGUE_ID <- 23701
SPORT     <- "NFL"
SEASON    <- 2026

# Use whatever weeks are already cached; never hit the API from this page.
cached <- list.files(here::here("data"), pattern = sprintf("^%d_week_\\d{2}\\.rds$", SEASON))
WEEK   <- max(as.integer(sub(".*_week_(\\d{2})\\.rds", "\\1", cached)))

all_weeks_data <- get_season_to_date(LEAGUE_ID, SPORT, SEASON, WEEK)
weekly_scores  <- weekly_team_scores(all_weeks_data)
log            <- season_matchup_log(all_weeks_data)
record         <- season_record(log)
all_play       <- all_play_record(weekly_scores)
luck           <- luck_table(record, all_play)
```

*Through Week `r WEEK`.*

## Standings

```{r standings}
record |>
  mutate(across(c(points_for, points_against, avg_for, avg_against), \(x) round(x, 1))) |>
  select(Team = team, Record = record, PF = points_for, PA = points_against,
         `Avg PF` = avg_for, `Avg PA` = avg_against) |>
  ff_kable()
```

## All-Play Record

Each team's record if it had played every other team every week. Removes schedule luck.

```{r all-play}
luck |>
  mutate(ap_pct = sprintf("%.3f", ap_pct)) |>
  select(Team = team, Actual = record, `All-Play` = all_play, `All-Play %` = ap_pct) |>
  arrange(desc(`All-Play %`)) |>
  ff_kable()
```

## Luck Index

Actual wins minus expected wins from all-play. Positive means the schedule has been kind.

```{r luck-chart, fig.height=5.5}
luck |>
  mutate(team = fct_reorder(team, luck)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = team, y = luck, fill = team)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey40") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_colors, na.value = "grey70") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Wins above expected") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## Points Against

```{r points-against, fig.height=5.5}
record |>
  mutate(team = fct_reorder(team, points_against)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = team, y = points_against, fill = team)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_colors, na.value = "grey70") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total points against") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## Weekly Scores

```{r weekly-scores, fig.height=6}
weekly_scores |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = total_points, color = fantasy_team_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = team_colors, na.value = "grey70", name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(WEEK)) +
  labs(x = "Week", y = "Points") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
